scenario: Actions per LGRA.15.16 — head + sequence of kwargs (`name: value`) and flags (bare identifiers). `call` mandatory cooldown or `nocooldown`. Pin verifies the kwarg+flag mix on a `call` action. `x` is declared `Int`, the kind of the `t.v` it is given: a mismatched builtin kwarg is a refusal ([LADP.8.5.4]), which is not what this vector is about.
rules_ds:
service svc.method:
    kwarg x: Int
    kwarg y: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.method x: t.v y: "lit" nocooldown
